en.headline: Hui says RMB government payments will not touch the peg
en.dek: The financial services chief told RTHK that using renminbi for some official spending is a matching exercise, with the Hong Kong dollar remaining the core.
body: Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui said paying some government bills in renminbi was meant to match inflows with outflows and had no bearing on the linked exchange rate.

Speaking on RTHK's Millennium on Thursday, Hui said the share of spending in renminbi would remain low and that the Hong Kong dollar would stay at the core of government expenditure and major tax receipts. He described the move as a change in scale rather than a change in kind, noting Hong Kong is already the largest offshore renminbi centre and that the government already issues multi-currency debt, including in renminbi.

The five-year plan published this month said the government would study more suitable uses for renminbi it already receives, including bond proceeds and, in future, stock stamp duty once renminbi counters join Stock Connect southbound. Hui said the city was in close contact with mainland regulators on the system work needed and hoped the arrangement could be launched as soon as possible.

Officials have previously cited East River water purchases and fees for civil service training on the mainland as possible trial cases, alongside existing payments to mainland providers under the Elderly Health Care Voucher scheme. Hui said a seven-day offshore renminbi liquidity facility and short-term offshore renminbi paper were part of the supporting toolkit to deepen circulation.

zh.headline: 許正宇：人民幣付政府開支與聯匯無關
zh.dek: 財庫局長在電台節目表示，以人民幣支付部分開支是為收支場景匹配，佔比不會高，核心仍是港元。
body: 財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇周四在香港電台節目《千禧年代》表示，以人民幣支付部分政府開支，是希望收支場景互相匹配，與聯繫匯率制度扯不上關係。
他強調政府開支與主要稅收仍會以港元為主，預計人民幣佔整體開支的比例一定不高，核心一定是港幣。他指今次並非「質的變化」，香港已是國家境外最大離岸人民幣中心，有關機制一直存在，政府亦一向有多幣種發債，包括人民幣，匯率管理屬恆常財政管理一部分。
本月公布的五年規劃提出，政府會帶頭研究在更多合適場景以人民幣支付開支。許正宇說，預期日後收取及使用人民幣的規模增加，人民幣櫃台將納入南向通，容許內地投資者以人民幣買股票及繳付印花稅。他指一直與內地監管機構緊密溝通，相關系統及技術安排希望盡快推出。
當局早前舉例，未來可研究以人民幣支付東江水及公務員內地培訓費用，現時亦已有場景如向內地醫療機構支付醫療券。許正宇提到，七日離岸人民幣流動資金投標機制及發行離岸人民幣短期債務工具，同屬加大境外人民幣流轉的配套。
